newsitem.title: UK: Christies says sales outlook encouraging.
newsitem.headline: Christies says sales outlook encouraging.

text.p: British auction house Christies International Plc said on Thursday its sales outlook for the rest of the year was encouraging.
"We are continuing to see good results in day-to-day sales" as well as in special ones, the firm said in a statement from its annual meeting.
Christies said the likely improvement in auction sales would benefit its revenues signicantly.
"However, in an increasingly competitive market, the costs associated with marketing, particularly for large single-owner collections, are also very significant," the company added.
Christies' shares firmed 3.0p to 306.5 by 1140 GMT.
